name: Kayla bin-Kroog
description: Kayla bin-Kroog is the widow of Urza, mother of Harbin and queen of Penregon, known for leading its people west and for writing The Antiquities War.

summary.text: Kayla bin-Kroog is the widow of Urza, mother of Harbin and queen of Penregon, known for leading its people west and for writing The Antiquities War.

bio.text: Five years after the cataclysm, Kayla reviewed grim grain reports in Penregon's council chambers and met Tawnos, whom she thought dead.

timeline.summary: At a second summit Mishra convinces Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone; Urza reclaims it and declares war, starting the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: This was the start of the Brothers' War.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of Kroog, Tawnos frees Ashnod and returns the Staff of Zegon so she will protect Kayla.
timeline.quote: Ashnod was let free by Tawnos

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod drains the Qadir's life with the Staff of Zegon, killing him, and Mishra becomes the last Qadir.
timeline.quote: Mishra himself became the last Qadir.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Raddic's crusade confronts Penregon and he issues an ultimatum to cast out the machines.
timeline.quote: Raddic issued an ultimatum: cast out the machines or face destruction.

citation.text: "Raddic", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza wins the contest in Kroog with an artificial warrior to marry Kayla.
timeline.quote: Urza's constructs an artificial warrior that he uses to win the contest

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Korlis conference the king of Kroog attacks Mishra's forces with ornithopters; open conflict erupts; Ashnod kills Urza's patron, and Urza's Mightstone bests Mishra, who flees cursing Urza and his house.
timeline.quote: Fleeing, Mishra curses Urza and his house.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of Kroog, Tawnos frees Ashnod to protect Kayla, and Ashnod kills the Qadir with the staff and helps Tawnos and Kayla escape by boat.
timeline.quote: The Qadir himself she made sure to kill, draining his life with the staff such that he collapsed, bleeding.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Yotia Urza builds a huge machine to move a jade statue, wins the contest and weds Kayla bin-Kroog to gain a Thran tome.
timeline.quote: He succeeded and was wed to Kayla bin-Kroog

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza wins Kayla's hand by having his automaton move a great statue.
timeline.quote: Urza's automaton succeeded

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Kayla grow close after her father's death.
timeline.quote: the couple grew closer

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra convinces Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone and sleep with him; Urza discovers them, reclaims the stone and declares war.
timeline.quote: he convinced Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone and sleep with him

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra returns with his army and dragon engines and destroys Kroog; Kayla flees pregnant with Harbin.
timeline.quote: In one morning, Kroog was destroyed

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kayla rules Penregon, rebuilds with Tawnos's automatons, and the Church of Tal besieges the city.
timeline.quote: initiated the Siege of Penregon in 69 AR

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Penregon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kayla leads the refugees west in 79 AR as Penregon falls.
timeline.quote: with the Fall of Penregon happening that autumn

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Penregon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kayla resolves to cross the continent hoping the legendary flying man is her son Harbin.
timeline.quote: Kayla resolved to cross the continent to learn the truth

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Penregon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza finds Kayla with Mishra, negotiations collapse and war is declared; Ashnod kills the Qadir and Mishra ascends as Qadir.
timeline.quote: Mishra would then ascend as Qadir and leader of the Fallaji.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Opposing sides of war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra seduces Kayla into stealing Urza's Mightstone at the Kroog peace talks; Urza reclaims it and Mishra flees.
timeline.quote: he convinced Kayla to sleep with him and steal Urza's Mightstone

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tawnos helps Kayla defend Penregon against the Church of Tal's siege.
timeline.quote: helped her to defend the city against the Church of Tal 's Siege of Penregon later that year.

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza builds a machine to move a jade statue and wins Kayla bin-Kroog's hand to obtain a Thran tome, then becomes Chief Artificer.
timeline.quote: Urza built a gigantic machine to move the statue.

citation.text: "Urza", section "Chief Artificer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Six years later Urza returns to say farewell to Tawnos and asks him to return to Kayla.
timeline.quote: Urza returned to Dominaria to say a final farewell to his student and good friend Tawnos

citation.text: "Urza", section "Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Five years after the cataclysm, Kayla sits alone in Penregon's council chambers reviewing grim grain reports and an empty map of the Visceral Sea.
timeline.quote: Kayla bin-Kroog sat alone in the council chambers of Penregon's government house

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tawnos, frostbitten and aged, arrives for a private meeting and Kayla tells him she thought he was dead.
timeline.quote: I thought you were dead.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla confronts Tawnos about the death of her son Harbin and says she will never forgive him.
timeline.quote: I will never forgive you for convincing me to allow my son to go off and die in my husband's war.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tawnos shows Urza's and his own designs, says he recovered powerstones and knows where Argive's buried stockpile lies, and offers to build tools to rebuild Penregon.
timeline.quote: I was able to recover a clutch of powerstones and know where we can find more.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla refuses to remember Urza as he wished and says she is glad he is gone.
timeline.quote: I will remember him as he was.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tawnos reveals that Urza is not dead but has become something else.
timeline.quote: Urza is not dead, ma'am.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla sends Tawnos to Urza's old factories with Myrel so he can begin building.
timeline.quote: Tomorrow, I will have Myrel, my scout captain, take you to the warehouses so you can begin.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Months later Myrel reports a ten-thousand-strong ragged march approaching, flying black banners and carrying machine remains and Ashnod's transmogrants; Tawnos says his civils can be armed.
timeline.quote: My best assumption is ten thousand

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The vast march arrives outside Penregon, and five black-clad emissaries ride toward the gates.
timeline.quote: They pointed toward a small clutch of black-clad riders that had broken away and begun riding for Penregon's gates.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla offers the emissaries entry on three conditions, and Raddic announces a crusade of penitents against machines.
timeline.quote: We are the living of Terisiare, who seek to clean this land of machine filth.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Raddic says the crusade is bound for the Iron Tower, and Kayla describes where it is hidden.
timeline.quote: It is well hidden in the mountains somewhere to the west or southwest.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla declines to join the crusade but allows refugees into the city with no weapons or soldiers.
timeline.quote: Your people are free to seek refuge in our city, but we ask that no soldiers enter.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Talites in the market attack one of Tawnos's civils; two pilgrims die in the guards' response, a guard is wounded and the rest are arrested.
timeline.quote: Two of the pilgrims are dead and one of our guards was wounded.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Myrel reports the marchers arming and Raddic approaching the gates, and Kayla refuses to hide.
timeline.quote: This is my city, captain. I will not hide when Penregon is threatened.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla orders Tawnos to arm the civils and Myrel to levy the militia.
timeline.quote: Tawnos, arm the civils,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla remembers fleeing the fall of Kroog while pregnant.
timeline.quote: She fled the city, pregnant with her son.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Raddic accuses Penregon of harboring machine demons and reveals that Talites living in the city told him of Tawnos and the civils.
timeline.quote: Many of the faithful arrived here years ago

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Raddic gives Penregon an ultimatum to drive out the machines and tear down the tower by dawn, and throws a spear at Kayla's feet.
timeline.quote: Choose: die with it or live with us!

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla tells Myrel to save the archers' arrows for the next day.
timeline.quote: Save our arrows,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla spends the siege in a command post with Jarsyl, deciding what to do with captured Talites.
timeline.quote: Kayla had spent the brutal day in a well-defended post with the commanders of the city guard and militia.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla and Myrel survey the burned factory and conclude that Tawnos set the fire himself and vanished.
timeline.quote: Tawnos did this,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Ten years later, silent summers, the frozen harbor and a stream of settlers westward mark Penregon's decline.
timeline.quote: Penregon's harbor suffered its first solid freeze.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Scouts report green lands in the west, and Kayla proclaims that Penregon's salvation lies there; thousands set out in caravans.
timeline.quote: proclaimed to the people of Penregon that their salvation lay in the distant west.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Scouts return from the north with news of glaciers and a frozen ocean, saying the world is ending.
timeline.quote: the scouts told Kayla that the world was ending.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Alone in her manor on a winter night, Kayla screams her grief until fire bursts from her hands, her first magic.
timeline.quote: Fire coursed up from some deep knot in her gut

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla studies Hurkyl's writings and learns to control her magic through a stone from Kroog.
timeline.quote: Kayla's new nightly practice followed the precepts of Hurkyl's meditative techniques as laid out in the book.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla orders the guildmasters and grain-lords to provision the migration and sends Myrel and the scouts west.
timeline.quote: Myrel went with them; Kayla saw them off

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The Talites return in a blizzard, learn that Raddic died after the Iron Tower and Mishra's forge, and march west.
timeline.quote: Many of the faithful died, Raddic among them.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla hears a story of a flying man in the western sky and leads a final caravan west out of Penregon.
timeline.quote: She prepared a final caravan of her people and went west with them

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The caravan crosses the Khers, losing a quarter of its number, and reaches the western lands along the Mardun.
timeline.quote: losing a quarter of their number to the cold, the dark, and the desperate creatures there.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla reaches New Yotia, lingers there, and resolves to cross the continent to learn the truth about Harbin.
timeline.quote: Kayla resolved to cross the continent to learn the truth.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla secretly displays her magic by snuffing and relighting the lamps.
timeline.quote: As one, the oil lamps Kayla had left burning snuffed out, then reignited.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jarsyl tells Kayla he cannot go with her because he wants to join a school of magic and artifice run by Nod and Duck, and Kayla blesses it.
timeline.quote: Go north. If there are teachers greater than me, seek them out.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla leaves New Yotia on a riverboat down the Mardun toward Kroog with Talite mercenaries aboard.
timeline.quote: So she did not protest when a detachment of dark-clad soldiers filed onto her riverboat.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Kaya and Saheeli plan how to find the true sylex's activation, and Teferi picks The Antiquities War as the key text, aiming for the Last Battle on Argoth.
timeline.quote: We go here—the last battle of the Brothers' War.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jarsyl leaves his grandmother and joins the Conclave of Mages as one of its first students.
timeline.quote: He left his grandmother Kayla and joined the Conclave of Mages

citation.text: "Jarsyl", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza marries Kayla bin-Kroog, princess of Yotia.
timeline.quote: Urza marries Kayla bin-Kroog , the princess of Yotia .

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: I'm sorry ma'am, but we haven't found him

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.
